7.description: [Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Arcanist Explosion] Fixed a bug where the spell power scaling of Arcanist Explosion was doubled. It is now equal to Arcane Explosion.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Endless Agony] Reduced the stacks of Endless Agony to 40, down from 50. In addition, Curse of Doom now deals 4% damage per stack, up from 3% per stack.

[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Darkmaster] Spiderbite no longer works while using the Legendary Mystic Enchant Darkmaster. This combination promoted unintended gameplay and limited the options of Darkmaster.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Arcane Thunder Seer] The Thunder Seer buff from Arcane Thunder Seer now also reduces the damage done by arcane missiles by 10% per stack.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Burning Darkness] Reduced the damage increase to Conflagrate from Flame Born stacks from Burning Darkness to 3% per stack, down from 5% per stack.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Dark Flames] Dark Flames now requires the final rank of Ignite.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Elemental Destruction] Reduced the base damage and scaling of Elemental Immolation and Energy Bolt from Elemental Destruction by 15%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Elemental Destruction] Disabled Stormstrike while using Elemental Destruction.

[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Demonic Persistence] Reduced the damage of summoned demons and Wild Imps from Demonic Influence to 80%, down from 100%. Damage against players is unchanged at 50%. In addition, Demonic Influence now no longer reduces the damage done from Metamorphosis, and will retain the 15% increased damage done. The damage bonus of Metamorphosis is now only reduced to 5% against players.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Demonic Persistence] Reduced the damage of Demonic Persistence (the explosion from sacrificing Wild Imps) by 16% at level 60 and 13% at level 70.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Demonic Persistence] Demonic Persistence now gives 20% increased damage per stack, down from 25%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Demonic Persistence] Demonic Persistence now stacks up to 4 times, down from 5.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Blood for the Blood God] Favor of the Soulflayer no longer increases your critical strike damage percent, down from 30% critical strike damage bonus.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Blood for the Blood God] Reduced the attack power scaling of Soul of the Soulflayer by 50%.

[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Blood for the Blood God] Fixed an issue where refreshing Rend with In for the Kill would keep the initial duration of Rend while increasing the tick frequency when having more haste after the initial application of Rend.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Blood for the Blood God] Reduced the duration increase to Garrote from Perforation to 1.5 seconds per Rend tick, down from 3 seconds per tick.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Blood for the Blood God] Reduced the damage increase of bleeds from Bathe in Blood to 5% per stack, down from 9% per stack.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Warden of the Demonreach] Winters Mantle and Gathering Will can no longer gain multiple stacks from the same ability.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Warden of the Demonreach] Winters Mantle stacks from Warden of Demonreach now increase the damage of your next Arctis by 20% per stack, down from 30% per stack.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] [Warden of the Demonreach] Gathering Will stacks from Warden of Demonreach now increase the damage of your next Fuego by 20% per stack, down from 30% per stack.

1.description: [Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Raging Blow now deals 195% weapon damage, up from 180%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Starlight Wrath now also increases the damage of Starsurge by 2/4/6%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Lunar Guidance now also increases the critical strike chance of Starsurge by 3/6/9%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Improved Moonfire now also increases the critical strike chance of Starsurge by 4/7/10%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] The Capstone effect of Improved Moonfire is now guaranteed to proc on your critical hits. It previously had a 75% proc chance.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] The capstone effect of Malice now also triggers from Crimson Tempest, in addition to Rupture and Garrote.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Increased the damage of Wrath by 5%.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Bloodsurge now also makes your next Bloodthirst refresh the duration of Bloodbath on the target.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Bloodbath now lasts for 8 seconds, up from 6 seconds.

[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Changed Swipe (Cat) to work as its equivalent Swipe (Bear), making it so that you do not need a target to use the ability. This makes it easier to use Swipe in dungeons on targets around you, if for example your previous target dies and your current target is out of range.
[Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Reduced the base damage and scaling of the damage over time effect of Shadowflame by 10% on all ranks.

5.description: [Thrall] [Upcoming changes] Felstriker weapon proc now no longer guarantees critical strikes for 3 seconds but instead increases your critical strike rating by 280 for 6 seconds with a 45s internal cooldown. This change fixes an issue where Felstriker was disproportionally powerful for snapshotting.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Piercing Cleaver did not have the correct rage cost, and was not properly scaling with melee attack power.
[Pending Restart] Increased the Execute modifier on the Weakness aura applied by Piercing Cleaver from 33% to 40% per stack.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Arugal's Gift from the Curse of Arugal Worldforged Mystic Enchantment was not properly benefitting from Impending Doom.
